# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest tagged release receives security updates.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues. Use
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/pdugan20/skills/security/advisories/new)
instead.

This collection ships agent instructions, templates, and small scripts that run
in the user's environment. Relevant reports include prompt-injection vectors,
unsafe generated instructions, command injection, path traversal, insecure
defaults, and supply-chain or packaging defects.
